title: Why Indigenous Tharparkar A2 Bilona Ghee Outperforms Commercial Dairy
excerpt: Discover why curd-churned Bilona ghee from desert-adapted Tharparkar cows is nutritionally distinct.
content: In the arid heartlands of Shekhawati and the Thar desert, the indigenous Tharparkar cow has evolved to survive extreme temperatures by grazing on medicinal desert flora. Pure Tharparkar cows exclusively produce A2 beta-casein milk.
At Lado Organics in Pilani, we boil whole A2 milk, culture it overnight into probiotic curd, and hand-churn it using a wooden Bilona during Brahma Muhurta.
It takes nearly 30 litres of pure milk to yield just 1 litre of our golden Bilona Ghee, rich in butyric acid, fat-soluble vitamins, and CLA.

title: The 'Cow as a Coconut' Philosophy: Inside Pilani's Zero-Waste Ecosystem
excerpt: How a single indigenous cow powers clean cooking gas, regenerates depleted desert soil, and sustains 100+ rural families.
content: In traditional Indian wisdom, the coconut tree is revered because every part serves human life with zero waste. We apply this exact blueprint to Gau Sanskriti in Pilani.
1. Calves like Dholi Sheri, Tara, and Roshni drink first[cite: 4].
2. Fresh dung fuels our biogas digester, and bioslurry creates Pure Kechua Khad vermicompost.
3. Sun-dried dung is crafted into chemical-free Tharparkar Dhoop.
